instruction: I am an NLP researcher building an author database. Find the ACL best paper awards from 2020 and 2021 on the ACL Anthology website and add them to the table best_awards_acl.xlsx on the desktop. For each paper, include the title, year, complete author list, and ACL Anthology PDF link. Make sure to list all authors separated only by commas (no 'and' or semicolons).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 5: Task asks to add 2 ACL best paper awards (2020, 2021) with complete information (title, year, authors, PDF link). Evaluator extracts all columns (A-D) and verifies: (1) at least 2 entries exist, (2) titles are present, (3) years are 2020 and 2021, (4) authors are comma-separated, and (5) PDF links contain aclanthology.org. Partial credit given based on percentage of complete entries, with penalty if both years not covered.

llm_judge_reasons: COMPLETE coverage: Evaluator correctly verifies all 4 instruction requirements (title, year, authors, PDF link)
Getter correctly extracts all 4 columns from spreadsheet (A=title, B=year, C=authors, D=pdf_link)
Metric correctly validates title: checks non-empty and reasonable length (>5 chars)
Metric correctly validates year: checks that year is 2020 or 2021 as required
Metric correctly validates author formatting: checks comma separation with no 'and' or semicolons as specified
Metric correctly validates PDF link: checks that link contains 'aclanthology.org'
Year coverage logic is sound: tracks years found and applies 30% penalty if both 2020 and 2021 not present
Partial credit calculation is appropriate: scores based on percentage of entries passing all 4 checks
Postconfig properly saves file with Ctrl+S before verification to ensure fresh data
Minor limitation (not a failure): Cannot verify papers are actually 'best paper awards' vs any ACL papers, but this would require gold standard list which is impractical for automatic verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding check for minimum title length to avoid trivial entries (current >5 is reasonable but could be stricter)
Could add URL format validation to ensure PDF links are well-formed URLs, not just contain 'aclanthology.org'
